modalLead: Recent bookmarks show the day you opened them, from every page. The tag view finds bookmarks with every tag, not just any of them. The action bar gets a theme studio button, and every window on the dashboard opens in the middle.

items.text: Recent bookmarks, with the day you opened them. Press *: tiles two across, from every page, each with the day, the time, its category or page and how often you opened it. Ten fit on a page; [ and ] page back and forward.
items.title: Recent bookmarks, with the day you opened them

media.alt: The Recent bookmarks sheet: tiles two across, each with the day it was opened, its time and category, and a pager below

items.text: Any tag or every tag. With two or more tags in the tag view, click the word between them: or shows bookmarks with any of them, and only those with every one.
items.title: Any tag or every tag

media.alt: The tag view with news and security: the word between them turns from or to and, the list narrows, and Add tag… appears for a ticked row

items.text: Add tag… Tick rows in the tag view and put one or more tags on all of them at once.
Sort by score, and the tag view remembers the sort you picked. Its search reads tags as well as names.
A theme studio button. The palette at the end of the action bar opens the theme studio, as Shift+A does. Switch it off under Config → Appearance → Action bar.
Every window on the dashboard opens in the middle: search, commands, Recent bookmarks, the pages panel and the tag cloud.
A docked action bar comes back when you rest the pointer on its edge, not on a quick pass on the way to the Dock, and goes again soon after you leave it.
The page filter (Shift+F) takes several words, opens a folded category with a hit, and ↓ or Enter jumps to the first row left.
The edit panel says what is in a block and offers its actions: add a bookmark, move to another page, delete. A width you cannot pick says why.
A right-click menu stays open in edit mode.
Glances Hosts lists the hosts in trouble first, sorts by any heading, names the fullest disk's mount and draws the processor's last hour.
The Inbox tile counts the links you snoozed, and shows a new or woken link without a reload.
Ocean is the theme a fresh install starts on. Your own theme stays as it is.
